P-07.title: Survey and Return
hints: A short road may be too steep.
Check both the return cost and slope.
Choose B, use dry 2, then tag 18 and 19.
P-07.mastery: Safe route and reserve at least 30, no blackout, all three beacons linked before their corners.

first_time_card.title: Survey and return
first_time_card.purpose: Plan the cold-trap route, survey ice and keep the return reserve.
steps: Compare the base slope card and the rover energy table.
Test each corner beacon before driving past it.
Calibrate the dry reference, then tag positive samples.
first_time_card.clip: Cold-trap route and scanner threshold (explainer clip pending)

P-08.title: Recover Without Ruining
hints: Warm dry seeds in their closed container.
Complete sleeve/cradle, then three warm-up stages in the glovebox before opening.
P-08.mastery: Sealed field recovery, three-stage dry warm-up with no condensation, twelve distinct vault specimens recorded and lid scanned.

first_time_card.title: Recover without ruining
first_time_card.purpose: Bring a cold seed case home without condensation damage.
steps: Probe, sleeve, cradle and latch the closed case in the field.
Warm the sealed container in three dry glovebox stages.
Confirm no condensation before opening and recording twelve specimens.
first_time_card.clip: Glovebox warm-up and vault inventory (explainer clip pending)

EX-CH04-S01.title: Make the Old Map Current
EX-CH04-S01.story_date: 21 October 2046 · descendant rack and prediction notebook
EX-CH04-S01.goal: Compare the May prediction against twelve current descendants
EX-CH04-S01.why: A prediction stays useful when kept beside the actual sample.

clues.text: Twelve descendants with text trait tags: seven purple stems, five green.
The saved May prediction, unchanged, beside the October observation panel.

EX-CH04-S01.aha: In this sample of twelve, seven purple and five green — not a promised ratio for every plant.
EX-CH04-S01.wrong_idea: Claim that seven to five proves a universal rule beyond the twelve-plant sample.
flight_rules: FR-06 · Keep original predictions unchanged and bound claims to the observed sample.
EX-CH04-S01.set_piece: Twelve descendant stems stand in the October rack beside the open May notebook.

EX-CH04-S02.title: Two Ledgers, One Expedition
EX-CH04-S02.story_date: 22 October 2046 · rover bay and base handover screen
EX-CH04-S02.goal: Prepare the rover and separate the base and rover ledgers
EX-CH04-S02.why: Two at base and two in the rover each use their own supplies.

clues.text: Two people at base, two on the rover's independent 48-hour manifest.
Ferreira confirms Rafi leads the field team and returning is part of the objective.

EX-CH04-S02.aha: Two at base, two in the rover. Each ledger counts its own people.
EX-CH04-S02.wrong_idea: Charge four people at base and two again in the rover.
flight_rules: FR-01 · Crew first, station second, science third.
FR-05 · Rover independent manifest covers the field team; never double-charge base air.
EX-CH04-S02.set_piece: Two occupied rover seats and two voices at home share the handover screen.

EX-CH04-S03.title: The Short Road and the Slope
EX-CH04-S03.goal: Choose the route that meets both the slope limit and the return reserve
EX-CH04-S03.why: A short road may be too steep; the return is already in the battery.

clues.text: Base slope card: route A max 24°, route B max 12°, route C max 18°. Rover limit is 15°.
Route energy cards from 100 units: A costs 35 each way (reserve 30), B ridge costs 30 each way (reserve 40), C shadow costs 40 each way (reserve 20).

EX-CH04-S03.aha: The short road looks fine on energy; it is the slope that blocks it. Route B keeps 40 reserve and stays at 12°.
EX-CH04-S03.wrong_idea: Pick Route A because 100 minus 70 leaves 30: its 24° slope exceeds the 15° rover limit.
flight_rules: FR-05 · Rover slope never above 15°; mandatory return reserve at least 30 of 100.
EX-CH04-S03.set_piece: The ridge bends out of sight beyond the rover window as the cabin heads toward the shadow.

EX-CH04-S04.title: Three Corners on the Ridge
EX-CH04-S04.story_date: 22 October 2046 · surveyed ridge and three beacon positions
EX-CH04-S04.goal: Place and link-test all three ridge beacons before blind corners
EX-CH04-S04.why: Placement is not communication; a beacon counts only when its link test passes.

clues.text: Each corner requires a passed next-hop link test before driving past.

EX-CH04-S04.aha: Only if the link test says so.
EX-CH04-S04.wrong_idea: Drive past a blind corner as soon as the beacon stands on its pad without testing the hop.
flight_rules: FR-05 · Maintain a verified communication chain across every blind ridge corner.

risk.title: Link lost at a blind corner

EX-CH04-S04.set_piece: Three relay beacons stand along the ridge rim against the black lunar sky.

EX-CH04-S05.title: Measure Before Claiming
EX-CH04-S05.story_date: 22 October 2046 · cold-trap reference and sample stations
EX-CH04-S05.goal: Calibrate the dry reference at 2, set threshold 12, tag 18 and 19, and keep 2 as negative control
EX-CH04-S05.why: Keep the negative sample. It is what makes the two positives believable.

clues.text: Kai asks whether the bright patch is ice; Amara requires the calibrated scanner reading.
Dry reference reads 2; threshold is reference plus 10 (12); sample points read 2, 18 and 19.

EX-CH04-S05.aha: Keep the negative sample. It is what makes the two positives believable.
EX-CH04-S05.wrong_idea: Tag every bright patch as water ice without calibrating the dry reference.
flight_rules: FR-06 · Calibrate dry reference before tagging positive samples; retain the negative control.
EX-CH04-S05.set_piece: The calibrated scanner chirps over the cold-trap floor under hard headlight beams.

EX-CH04-S06.title: That Shape Did Not Grow There
EX-CH04-S06.goal: Seal the ice sample and verify the return route before approaching the case
EX-CH04-S06.why: Two discoveries are two records, and curiosity stays inside the return reserve.

clues.text: A manufactured corner beyond the survey marker matches the 2034 deposit sheet.
Return reserve checked at 40 before recovery begins.

EX-CH04-S06.aha: Two discoveries are two separate records.
EX-CH04-S06.wrong_idea: Combine the ice sample and the seed case into a single unsealed find.
flight_rules: FR-05 · Verify return reserve before adding recovery work.
EX-CH04-S06.set_piece: The headlight sweep finds a straight manufactured edge in a world of rock under a black sky.

EX-CH04-S07.title: The Lid Can Wait
EX-CH04-S07.goal: Read the external probe, fit the insulated sleeve, latch the cradle and secure the cargo mount
EX-CH04-S07.why: Opening a cold seed case in warm humid air causes condensation.

clues.text: External probe reads the cold outer shell; inner biological seal is intact.
Probe, sleeve, cradle and mount keep the inner seal closed until home.

EX-CH04-S07.wrong_idea: Open the biological seal in the field to save time later.
flight_rules: FR-06 · Never open a cold biological container outside dry quarantine warm-up.

risk.title: Cold vault opened in cabin air

EX-CH04-S07.set_piece: The sealed case lifts continuously from its cold-trap deposit into the insulated cradle.

EX-CH04-S08.title: Three Stages in the Glovebox
EX-CH04-S08.story_date: 23 October 2046 · Aurora airlock and dry quarantine glovebox
EX-CH04-S08.goal: Return with reserve intact, dock in the dry glovebox, warm cold to cool to room, check condensation and inventory twelve specimens
EX-CH04-S08.why: Warm dry seeds in their closed container before opening the inner seal.

clues.text: Mount shows closed and passes its lock test before the return leg.
Dry glovebox stages: cold to cool to room, condensation NONE, then open for twelve distinct specimen labels.

EX-CH04-S08.aha: Stable and dry first; then open the inner seal inside the glovebox.
EX-CH04-S08.wrong_idea: Skip the cool stage or open the inner seal before checking for condensation.
flight_rules: FR-06 · Three-stage sealed warm-up and zero condensation check before opening.
EX-CH04-S08.set_piece: Light shifts from rover-cabin blue to warm habitat white as the sealed case docks to the dry glovebox.

EX-CH04-S09.title: Twelve in the Dark
EX-CH04-S09.goal: Scan the lid inscription, record viability as pending, and transfer the case to quarantine storage
EX-CH04-S09.why: Intact labels prove preservation, not germination; viability stays pending until tested.

clues.text: Saved reserve prediction kept beside the actual final reading of 40.

EX-CH04-S09.aha: Keep the forecast beside the actual reading, and mark viability pending until tested.
EX-CH04-S09.wrong_idea: Mark all twelve recovered seed lots healthy before any germination test.
flight_rules: FR-06 · Set quarantine status to pending viability evaluation, never assumed healthy.
EX-CH04-S09.set_piece: Inside the dry glovebox, the lid scan resolves into a line of handwriting.

EX-CH04-S10.title: Twelve Distinct Specimens
EX-CH04-S10.goal: Reconcile the twelve-specimen manifest, confirm all four crew home, and complete quarantine records
EX-CH04-S10.why: Physical seed stock and album records live in separate ledgers.

clues.text: Twelve distinct specimens with twelve condition entries, including cotton.

EX-CH04-S10.aha: An album entry is a record; the vault holds twelve physical specimens.
EX-CH04-S10.wrong_idea: Add collection album pages to the physical seed count.
flight_rules: FR-06 · Keep physical vault inventory separate from the founder reserve and album entries.

risk.title: Album records mixed with seed stock

EX-CH04-S10.set_piece: Twelve specimen wells sit in soft light inside the glovebox.

EX-CH04-S11.title: Ask Commander Ferreira
EX-CH04-S11.story_date: 23 October 2046 · scan station and Earth console
EX-CH04-S11.goal: Send the reconciled manifest, record the lid question for Ferreira, and leave the writer's identity open
EX-CH04-S11.why: The lid inscription supports a respectful question, not a verdict.

clues.text: The lid says: ask Commander Ferreira about Expedition Zero.
Rao confirms manifest receipt and unchanged safety support.

EX-CH04-S11.aha: The case was preserved on purpose, and the lid tells us who to ask.
EX-CH04-S11.wrong_idea: Attach a final verdict about who was abandoned in 2034.
flight_rules: FR-06 · Send exact evidence and the reconciled manifest; keep unverified names open.
EX-CH04-S11.set_piece: The Earth console holds a quiet pause before Rao answers.

EX-CH04-S12.title: The Fifth Mug
EX-CH04-S12.story_date: 24 October to 12 December 2046 · mission table and prepared locker
EX-CH04-S12.goal: Verify Ferreira's relief flight schedule, prepare the fifth locker, and confirm the December transition
EX-CH04-S12.why: A person cannot command from Earth and stand on the Moon without a transit flight.

clues.text: Ferreira's relief flight departs Earth 8 December and arrives 12 December; the fifth mug waits on the table.

EX-CH04-S12.aha: The fifth mug waits for the 12 December lander.
EX-CH04-S12.wrong_idea: Assume Ferreira arrives without transit while still on the Earth console.
flight_rules: FR-01 · Prepare five-person occupancy before the relief lander docks.
EX-CH04-S12.set_piece: The fifth mug sits on the Commons table beside a prepared locker.

p07_compare_prediction.title: Compare the May prediction
p07_compare_prediction.goal: Keep the May stem-colour prediction beside the October observation
p07_compare_prediction.why: A prediction is useful because it stays unchanged beside what grew.

p07_inspect_twelve_descendants.title: Inspect twelve descendants
p07_inspect_twelve_descendants.goal: Count seven purple stems and five green stems in the current twelve-plant cohort
p07_inspect_twelve_descendants.why: Describe what grew in this sample of twelve.

p07_record_trait_limits.title: Record sample scope
p07_record_trait_limits.goal: Record seven purple and five green as a twelve-plant sample, not a universal ratio
p07_record_trait_limits.why: Twelve plants do not prove a fixed law for every future tray.

p07_check_rover_seal.title: Check rover cabin seal
p07_check_rover_seal.goal: Verify the pressurised rover cabin seal before departure
p07_check_rover_seal.why: The rover carries its own atmosphere for Kai and Rafi.

p07_check_scanner.title: Check calibrated ice scanner
p07_check_scanner.goal: Verify the ice scanner is packed with its dry reference calibration card
p07_check_scanner.why: A bright patch is not a measurement without a calibrated scanner.

p07_check_closed_carrier.title: Check insulated sleeve and carrier
p07_check_closed_carrier.goal: Confirm the insulated sleeve, cradle and sample cups are aboard

p07_complete_base_handover.title: Separate base and rover ledgers
p07_complete_base_handover.goal: Confirm two cadets on the base ledger and two on the rover's 48-hour manifest
p07_complete_base_handover.why: Each ledger counts its own people once.

p07_choose_route_b.title: Choose the cold-trap route
p07_choose_route_b.goal: Select the route that stays within 15° slope and keeps at least 30 return reserve
p07_choose_route_b.why: Both slope and round-trip reserve must pass before departure.

options.label: Route A · Short canyon (8 km, 35 each way, max 24°)
options.detail: 100 − 35 − 35 = 30 reserve, but 24° exceeds the 15° rover limit.
options.feedback: Route A is blocked by Flight Rule FR-05: its 24° slope exceeds the 15° rover limit even though its reserve reaches 30.

options.label: Route B · Surveyed ridge (12 km, 30 each way, max 12°)
options.detail: 100 − 30 − 30 = 40 reserve (at least 30) and 12° is within the 15° limit.

options.label: Route C · Shadow floor (10 km, 40 each way, max 18°)
options.feedback: Route C fails both constraints: 18° exceeds the 15° slope limit and 20 reserve is below the mandatory 30.

p07_verify_slope.title: Verify maximum route slope
p07_verify_slope.goal: Enter the maximum slope on Route B (12°, within the 15° limit)
p07_verify_slope.why: The base slope card and the rover headlight view must agree on a drivable grade.

feedback.wrong: The surveyed ridge route has a 12° maximum slope, safely below the 15° rover limit.
feedback.low: Enter a non-negative slope reading from the route card.

p07_verify_return_reserve.title: Verify round-trip return reserve
p07_verify_return_reserve.goal: Enter the rover reserve remaining after 30 outbound and 30 return from 100 (40 units)
p07_verify_return_reserve.why: 100 minus 30 outbound minus 30 return leaves 40, above the mandatory 30 reserve.

feedback.wrong: Subtract 30 outbound and 30 return from 100: Route B leaves 40 reserve, above the 30 minimum.
feedback.low: The rover must keep at least 30 return-reserve units.

p07_prepare_departure.title: Commit ridge departure
p07_prepare_departure.goal: Confirm both slope and reserve checks and depart for the surveyed ridge
p07_prepare_departure.why: Returning is part of the objective.

p07_place_beacon_1.title: Place and link-test beacon one
p07_place_beacon_1.goal: Mount beacon one on its approved pad and verify the link to Aurora before the first blind corner
p07_place_beacon_1.why: A beacon counts only when its next-hop link test passes.

p07_place_beacon_2.title: Place and link-test beacon two
p07_place_beacon_2.goal: Align beacon two on the mid-ridge pad and pass the hop test to beacon one
p07_place_beacon_2.why: Each corner is a Go/No-Go on communication continuity.

p07_place_beacon_3.title: Place and link-test beacon three
p07_place_beacon_3.goal: Mount beacon three at the cold-trap rim and verify the full three-beacon chain
p07_place_beacon_3.why: All three beacons link the shadow floor back to Aurora.

p07_record_dry_reference.title: Record dry reference reading
p07_record_dry_reference.goal: Touch the scanner to the dry reference patch and record baseline signal 2
p07_record_dry_reference.why: Every positive claim depends on a known dry reference.

p07_set_threshold_12.title: Set calibrated detection threshold
p07_set_threshold_12.goal: Choose dry reference 2 and detection threshold 2 + 10 = 12
p07_set_threshold_12.why: Only readings at or above reference plus 10 count as verified ice.

options.label: Uncalibrated visual brightness (threshold 0)
options.detail: Treat every bright surface patch as water ice.
options.feedback: Visual brightness alone cannot prove water ice. Use dry reference 2 plus 10 for threshold 12.

options.label: Calibrated threshold: dry reference 2 + 10 = 12
options.detail: Baseline 2 plus the 10-unit margin sets the threshold at 12.

p07_tag_positive_18.title: Tag first positive sample (18)
p07_tag_positive_18.goal: Verify and tag sample reading 18 above the threshold of 12
p07_tag_positive_18.why: Reading 18 is six units above the calibrated threshold.

feedback.wrong: Only readings 18 and 19 are above the threshold of 12 in the cold-trap survey.
feedback.low: Reading 2 is at the dry baseline; choose a positive reading above 12.

p07_tag_positive_19.title: Tag second positive sample (19)
p07_tag_positive_19.goal: Verify and tag sample reading 19 above the threshold of 12
p07_tag_positive_19.why: Repeating and tagging the second positive reading confirms patchy ice.

feedback.wrong: Only readings 18 and 19 are positive in the supplied survey.
feedback.low: Choose the second positive reading above threshold 12.

p07_retain_negative_2.title: Retain negative control (2)
p07_retain_negative_2.goal: Record sample reading 2 as the negative control alongside 18 and 19
p07_retain_negative_2.why: Keeping the negative sample is what makes the two positives believable.

feedback.wrong: Reading 2 is the negative control that matches the dry reference.

p07_seal_sample.title: Seal positive ice sample
p07_seal_sample.goal: Seal one verified positive sample in its container separately from the vault case
p07_seal_sample.why: Two discoveries require two separate records.

p07_commit_return_route.title: Verify return reserve before recovery
p07_commit_return_route.goal: Confirm the 40-unit return reserve on Route B before starting the vault recovery
p07_commit_return_route.why: Curiosity stays inside the return plan.

p08_read_external_probe.title: Read external shell probe
p08_read_external_probe.goal: Measure the cold outer shell while leaving the inner biological seal untouched
p08_read_external_probe.why: Shell temperature is not a reason to open the case outside.

p08_fit_sleeve.title: Fit insulated sleeve
p08_fit_sleeve.goal: Slide the insulated thermal sleeve over the closed vault case
p08_fit_sleeve.why: The sleeve prevents rapid thermal shock during transport.

p08_latch_cradle.title: Latch transport cradle
p08_latch_cradle.goal: Seat the sleeved case into the two-point transport cradle
p08_latch_cradle.why: Probe, sleeve, cradle — inner seal stays closed.

p08_secure_mount.title: Secure and lock-test rover mount
p08_secure_mount.goal: Latch the cradle to the rover cargo mount and verify the physical lock test
p08_secure_mount.why: An indicator showing closed is verified by a pull test.

p08_return_to_base.title: Return to Aurora airlock
p08_return_to_base.goal: Complete the return leg along the three-beacon ridge with 40 reserve remaining
p08_return_to_base.why: The saved reserve forecast is kept beside the actual arrival reading.

p08_dock_dry_glovebox.title: Dock sealed case in dry glovebox
p08_dock_dry_glovebox.goal: Transfer the unopened case into the dry nitrogen quarantine glovebox
p08_dock_dry_glovebox.why: Dry glovebox air prevents moisture from condensing on cold metal and seeds.

p08_warm_cold.title: Begin sealed warm-up (cold stage)
p08_warm_cold.goal: Start the three-stage sealed warm-up from the cold baseline toward cool
p08_warm_cold.why: Gradual warming in a closed dry container protects dry seed coats.

options.label: Open inner seal immediately while cold
options.detail: Skip staged warming to inspect the seeds right away.
options.feedback: Blocked by Flight Rule FR-06: opening a cold container before dry warm-up causes condensation on the dry specimens.

options.label: Keep sealed and advance from cold to cool stage
options.detail: First confirmed warm-up stage inside the dry glovebox.

p08_warm_cool.title: Hold cool equilibration stage
p08_warm_cool.goal: Confirm temperature stabilisation at the intermediate cool stage
p08_warm_cool.why: Each warm-up stage equilibrates before the next step.

p08_warm_room.title: Finish sealed warm-up (room stage)
p08_warm_room.goal: Complete the third warm-up stage to room temperature while still sealed
p08_warm_room.why: The sealed warm-up finishes at room stage before the condensation check.

options.label: Open while still cool
options.feedback: The sealed warm-up must finish at room stage so no temperature differential remains when opened.

p08_check_condensation.title: Verify zero condensation
p08_check_condensation.goal: Confirm no condensation formed during the three-stage dry warm-up
p08_check_condensation.why: Stable and dry is the gate to opening the inner biological seal.

p08_open_inner_seal.title: Open inner biological seal
p08_open_inner_seal.goal: Unlatch the inner biological seal inside the dry quarantine glovebox
p08_open_inner_seal.why: All three warm-up stages and the dry check have passed.

p08_inventory_12.title: Inventory twelve vault specimens
p08_inventory_12.goal: Count the 12 distinct physical seed specimens in the vault wells (separate from album pages)
p08_inventory_12.why: Twelve distinct specimens, twelve condition entries.

feedback.wrong: Count only the twelve physical specimen wells in the vault case, not collection album pages.
feedback.low: The vault inventory requires all twelve distinct specimens.

p08_scan_lid.title: Scan inner lid inscription
p08_scan_lid.goal: Scan the handwritten note inside the vault lid
p08_scan_lid.why: The lid says: ask Commander Ferreira about Expedition Zero.

p08_save_viability_pending.title: Set quarantine viability status
p08_save_viability_pending.goal: Record the twelve dry specimens as pending viability evaluation, not assumed healthy
p08_save_viability_pending.why: Dry storage preserves labels and seed coats; germination requires its own later test.

p08_transfer_case.title: Store vault lot in quarantine bay
p08_transfer_case.goal: Lock the twelve-specimen vault ledger separately from the thirty founder seeds
p08_transfer_case.why: Each seed collection keeps its own chain of custody.

p08_manifest_reconciled.title: Reconcile vault manifest
p08_manifest_reconciled.goal: Match all twelve specimen labels to the 2034 vault ledger
p08_manifest_reconciled.why: Every well matches its recorded cultivar and condition entry.

p08_personnel_home.title: Confirm field team home
p08_personnel_home.goal: Close the rover manifest with Kai and Rafi safely back inside Aurora

p08_quarantine_complete.title: Sign quarantine completion
p08_quarantine_complete.goal: Sign the dry-quarantine handover for the twelve vault specimens
p08_quarantine_complete.why: Cotton and eleven companion lots remain sealed pending approved planting.

p08_send_manifest.title: Send reconciled manifest to Earth
p08_send_manifest.goal: Transmit the twelve-specimen manifest and lid scan to Earth support

p08_record_ferreira_question.title: Include the lid question for Ferreira
p08_record_ferreira_question.goal: Ask Commander Ferreira what happened to Expedition Zero's garden
p08_record_ferreira_question.why: The inscription supports a question, not a verdict.

p08_leave_identity_open.title: Keep the writer's name open
p08_leave_identity_open.goal: Leave the gardener's full name unguessed until signed evidence is shared
p08_leave_identity_open.why: An initial on a lid is not a full identity.

p08_check_relief_flight.title: Check December relief flight schedule
p08_check_relief_flight.goal: Confirm Ferreira departs Earth 8 December and lands at Aurora 12 December
p08_check_relief_flight.why: Transit dates explain when the fifth crew member joins the station.

p08_prepare_locker.title: Prepare the fifth locker and mug
p08_prepare_locker.goal: Ready the fifth locker and place Ferreira's mug at the Commons table
p08_prepare_locker.why: Welcome the engineer home with a prepared station.

p08_confirm_december_transition.title: Confirm December handover
p08_confirm_december_transition.goal: Close Chapter 4 with Route B verified, 12 vault specimens quarantined, and five-crew prep ready
p08_confirm_december_transition.why: The station is ready for the December relief landing.
